{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Drop the six QA orders with revenue 999999.99
df = df[df['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Drop refunded orders (status == 'refunded')
df = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Now compute conversion rate by channel
table = pd.crosstab(df['channel'], df['converted'], normalize='index')

# Extract conversion rates
df_rates = table.reset_index()
df_rates.columns = ['channel', 'not_converted', 'converted']

effect = df_rates[df_rates['channel'] == 'email']['converted'].values[0] - \
         df_rates[df_rates['channel'] == 'paid_search']['converted'].values[0]

effect"}
